parameters.name: ConsumerId
parameters.description:
The name of the consumer group.

*   The value can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_), and the value must contain at least one letter or digit.
*   The value must be 3 to 128 characters in length. If the value that you specify contains more than 128 characters, the system automatically truncates the value to 128 characters.
*   After a consumer group is created, you cannot change the name of the consumer group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The description of the consumer group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka create-consumer-group --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-0pp1l9z80000 --consumer-id test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --remark test --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka CreateConsumerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --InstanceId 'alikafka_post-cn-0pp1l9z80000' --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ConsumerId test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Remark test
